lastCompletedStory.title: Clear stale plan-verdict-report.json and prd.json at plan-phase start

nextStoryContext: US-002 added clearStalePlanArtifactsFn to RunPlanPhaseOptions (plan-runner.ts) and calls it at the very top of runPlanPhase before preflight. Production wiring in sidecar.ts extracts makeClearStalePlanArtifacts(cwd) helper (mirrors host.ts makeClearReviewReport) which unlinks both PLAN_VERDICT_REPORT_FILENAME and scripts/cam/prd.json best-effort. File-size budget raised: sidecar.ts 960->985 (tracker CAM-155). All quality gates pass (2605/2605 tests, typecheck clean, check:all exit 0). Next story US-003 uses the prd.json clearing to detect planner-no-prd as a distinct failure: readPlannerReportFn returning null after the phase means the planner produced nothing.

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in internal cam-cli helpers and built-in node:fs (existsSync, unlinkSync). No external npm library was added or changed.
